name: Brotherhood of Stokers & Miners
description: The men and women who dig the coal, cut the stone, feed the fireboxes and fell the timber. Proud, hard-worked, and suspicious of any machine that does a stoker's job.

name: Artisans' Guild
description: Smiths, tailors, machinists, bakers, canners and apothecaries. They take pride in the work of their hands, and want a fair share of what it earns.

name: Engineers' Institute
description: The colony's engineers and galvanists. They dream of a town run by clockwork and calculating engines, and like nothing better than seeing automatons at work anywhere in the colony.

name: Land & Water Union
description: Farmers, fishers, hunters, foresters and glasshouse keepers. They feed the colony, and the smoke that blackens their fields and drives off the game is their first grievance.
